query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `pledges` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `donorId` int,
  `donorName` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `donorEmail` varchar(320),
  `campaignId` int,
  `totalAmount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `paidAmount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `currency` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GBP',
  `description` text,
  `dueDate` timestamp,
  `status` enum('pending','partial','fulfilled','overdue','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `isGiftAid` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `reminderSentAt` timestamp,
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `pledges_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `pledge_payments` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `pledgeId` int NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `paymentMethod` enum('cash','bank_transfer','card','cheque','online') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash',
  `paidAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `notes` text,
  `recordedById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `pledge_payments_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `major_donor_due_diligence` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `donorId` int,
  `donorName` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `donorEmail` varchar(320),
  `donationAmount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int,
  `sourceOfFunds` text,
  `pepCheck` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `sanctionsCheck` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `idVerified` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `idDocumentType` varchar(100),
  `idDocumentRef` varchar(200),
  `notes` text,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','flagged','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `reviewedById` int,
  `reviewedAt` timestamp,
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `major_donor_due_diligence_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `donor_pipeline` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `donorId` int,
  `donorName` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `donorEmail` varchar(320),
  `stage` enum('prospect','contacted','interested','pledged','converted','lapsed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prospect',
  `assignedToId` int,
  `assignedToName` varchar(200),
  `estimatedValue` decimal(12,2),
  `campaignId` int,
  `nextActionDate` timestamp,
  `nextActionNote` text,
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `donor_pipeline_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `donor_notes` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `donorId` int NOT NULL,
  `note` text NOT NULL,
  `authorId` int NOT NULL,
  `authorName` varchar(200),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `donor_notes_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `bulk_message_approvals` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int,
  `requestedById` int NOT NULL,
  `requestedByName` varchar(200),
  `recipientCount` int NOT NULL,
  `messageSubject` varchar(500),
  `messagePreview` text,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `reviewedById` int,
  `reviewedByName` varchar(200),
  `reviewedAt` timestamp,
  `reviewNotes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `bulk_message_approvals_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conflicts_of_interest` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `trusteeId` int NOT NULL,
  `trusteeName` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `donorId` int,
  `donorName` varchar(200),
  `donationAmount` decimal(12,2),
  `disclosedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `resolvedAt` timestamp,
  `resolution` text,
  `status` enum('open','resolved','noted') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `conflicts_of_interest_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `saved_views` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `entity` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'donors',
  `filters` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `saved_views_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `qr_codes` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int,
  `campaignName` varchar(300),
  `label` varchar(200),
  `targetUrl` text NOT NULL,
  `utmSource` varchar(100),
  `utmMedium` varchar(100),
  `utmCampaign` varchar(200),
  `scanCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `qr_codes_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `recognition_tiers` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int,
  `name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `minAmount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `maxAmount` decimal(12,2),
  `description` text,
  `benefits` text,
  `color` varchar(50),
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `recognition_tiers_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
